create_Pdf_feature: create a Pdf Feature to read pdf documents from a file path in a HuggingFace dataset
encode_example_Pdf: encode a pdf file path or bytes into an Arrow-compatible dictionary using Pdf.encode_example
decode_example_Pdf: decode a stored pdf dictionary back into a pdfplumber PDF object using Pdf.decode_example
cast_storage_Pdf: cast a PyArrow string or binary array to the Pdf struct storage type using Pdf.cast_storage
encode_pdfplumber_pdf: encode a pdfplumber PDF object into a path or bytes dictionary using encode_pdfplumber_pdf
